questions.question: Is the rumour of mental corruption true?
How does poison defend against demons?

description:
Rumours associate prolonged poison exposure with mental corruption; neither the cause nor Koga’s fate is established.

A rumor associated with the later Koga communities, not narrator-confirmed biology. When written, its scene must identify a particular speaker and their evidence; do not insert it into ordinary opening NPC dialogue.

data.description: The rumor does not establish his fate or turn the imitation into a corrupted real Koga.

sections: Sections 2–3: confirmed foundations, origin distinctions and unresolved cosmology
